summary_1line: Bhishma explains the righteous code of warfare for kings: fight fairly, spare the helpless, treat the defeated justly, and never pursue victory through unrighteous means.

image_candidates.scene_text: A wounded enemy warrior is carried from the battlefield while physicians tend his wounds under the victor king’s protection.
Two evenly matched chariot warriors face each other on an open battlefield, both armored and ready, observing the rules of honorable combat.
A lone Brahmana steps fearlessly between two opposing armies, raising his hand to halt the battle.
